Almost made it in 30 minutes… fine, it was 43 😅 but look at THIS. Juicy lemony chicken ktzitzot, fluffy baked rice, and my favorite crunchy coleslaw… aka a full dinner everyone actually wants to eat. Kids are obsessed, parents get a win, and the best part? 👉 Leftovers = tomorrow night’s dinner ✔️ Save this one… you’ll be making it on repeat. Chicken Meatballs * 1½ lbs ground chicken (dark or white meat) * 1 medium sweet potato, grated * 1 onion, finely chopped * ½ bunch cilantro, chopped * ½ bunch dill, chopped * ½ bunch parsley, chopped * 2–3 tbsp oil * 2 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp turmeric Sauce * 1 package frozen peas * 4–5 celery ribs, chopped * Juice of 1 lemon * 2 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp turmeric * 3 cups chicken stock (or water + consommé) Baked Rice * 2 cups raw basmati rice * 3 cups chicken stock (or water + consommé) * Drizzle of oil Easy Coleslaw * ½ white cabbage, shredded * 2 carrots, shredded * 1–2 garlic cloves, minced * ¼ cup oil * ¼ cup white distilled vinegar * 1–2 tsp salt * 1 tbsp sugar Instructions Bake the rice by combining all the ingredients in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cover tightly with parchment paper and foil, then bake at 400°F for 30 minutes. Mix together all of the meatball ingredients until well combined. In a large pot, sauté 1 chopped onion in about ¼ cup oil until golden. Add the salt, pepper, and turmeric, then place the meatballs into the pot. Cover and cook for about 7 minutes, turning once. Add the peas, celery, lemon juice, and chicken stock. Cover and cook for another 10 minutes. For the coleslaw, combine all the ingredients and toss well. Serve the lemony chicken ktzitzot over fluffy baked rice with a generous side of crunchy coleslaw, and enjoy one of the easiest comfort meals you’ll make all week. 🤍 #sivanskitchen #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal #EasyRecipe #bakedrice

A spoonful of chili oil and seafood make everything hotter and better.🔥 Shrimp heads, soft tofu, crab, octopus, and juicy shrimp simmer into a rich, spicy broth that’s guaranteed to bring you back to life❤️‍🔥 Would you try this after a night out?🍜✨ 📍 Tag your late-night buddy & save this recipe for your next rough morning ✨ Hailey’s Hangover Seafood Tofu Ramen 📝 Ingredients * 2–3 tbsp chili oil * 2 eggs * 1 green onion, chopped * 2–3 cloves garlic, sliced * 1 pack Shin Ramyun (soup base + veggie packet) * 2 cups water * 3–5 large shrimp (heads separated) * 1 small crab * Baby octopus * Soft tofu * Rice cakes * A handful of bok choy (or bean sprouts) * Fresh red chili, sliced 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Heat the chili oil over medium heat. Crack in one egg and let the edges crisp slightly. 2. Add the shrimp heads, crab, baby octopus, garlic, and green onion. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. 3. Remove the egg and octopus so they don’t overcook. 4. Stir in the Shin Ramyun soup base and veggie packet, then pour in the water. Bring to a boil. 5. Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili. Enjoy immediately. 💡 Tip: Add a splash of soy sauce if the broth needs a little more seasoning.  #asmrfood #mukbang #ramenhacks #hangovercure #fyp
